description: Amazon Cognito User Pools adapter implementing the provider-neutral Ankhorage auth port.

exports.name: CognitoAuthConfig
exports.description: Server/host-owned adapter dependencies; credentials remain within the SDK client.

exports.name: CognitoAuthorizationAttempt
exports.description: Persist an OAuth PKCE authorization attempt with atomic one-time consumption.

exports.name: CognitoJwtVerifier
exports.description: Verify JWTs against this User Pool, app client, expiry, signature, and token use.

exports.name: CognitoPasswordResetCompletionInput
exports.description: Complete a previously requested password reset with the received confirmation code.

exports.name: CognitoPublicConfig
exports.description: Public User Pool configuration; no AWS credentials or client secrets.

exports.name: CognitoSessionStore
exports.description: Persist browser or native session tokens in a host-owned secure store.

exports.name: CognitoSignUpConfirmationInput
exports.description: Confirm registration without claiming Cognito has issued a signed session.

exports.name: CognitoVerifiedClaims
exports.description: Verified claims contain the stable Cognito sub identifier.

exports.name: confirmCognitoPasswordResetAsync
exports.description: Complete Cognito's password reset with a confirmed code and user-supplied new password.

exports.name: confirmCognitoSignUpAsync
exports.description: Confirm registration without issuing or pretending to possess a Cognito session.

exports.name: createCognitoAuthAdapter
exports.description: Implement the portable AuthPort through a host-owned AWS Cognito User Pool client.

sourceFunctions.name: now

sourceFunctions.name: startAuthorizationAsync

sourceFunctions.name: buildAuthorizationUrlAsync
sourceFunctions.description: Construct a registered Cognito authorize URL with S256 PKCE, state and nonce.

sourceFunctions.name: completeAuthorizationAsync
sourceFunctions.description: Consume one callback attempt and reject expired, replayed, or mismatched authorization.

sourceFunctions.name: exchangeAuthorizationCodeAsync
sourceFunctions.description: Redeem the one-time code and retain only validated Cognito sessions.

sourceFunctions.name: verifiedOAuthSessionAsync
sourceFunctions.description: Require matching signed access/ID subjects and the exact originating OAuth nonce.

sourceFunctions.name: authorizationDomain
sourceFunctions.description: Restrict Cognito authorization to a configured HTTPS endpoint.

sourceFunctions.name: resolveProvider
sourceFunctions.description: Never accept an unconfigured federated identity provider or arbitrary identity_provider.

sourceFunctions.name: randomToken
sourceFunctions.description: Generate a cryptographically random base64url PKCE verifier, state, or nonce.

sourceFunctions.name: pkceChallenge
sourceFunctions.description: Bind the authorization code to its originating client with an S256 challenge.

sourceFunctions.name: parseCallback
sourceFunctions.description: Validate callback location and reject duplicate or missing OAuth parameters.

sourceFunctions.name: isTokenResponse
sourceFunctions.description: Decode the untrusted token response without accepting incomplete or malformed sessions.

sourceFunctions.name: startFailure
sourceFunctions.description: Produce an OAuth start error with no callback, code, or token details.

sourceFunctions.name: completeFailure
sourceFunctions.description: Produce an OAuth completion error with no sensitive provider payload.

sourceFunctions.name: oauthError
sourceFunctions.description: Normalize Cognito OAuth errors using released portable Auth contracts.

sourceFunctions.name: now
sourceFunctions.description: Resolve the injected deterministic clock for durable OAuth attempt expiration.
